bare.name: Bare React Native
bare.summary: Plain react-native with the community template. You own ios/ and android/.
bare.tradeoff: Native changes are yours to make and to keep working on upgrades.

expo.name: Expo
expo.summary: Expo SDK with Continuous Native Generation. Native folders are generated, not committed.
expo.tradeoff: Versions are decided per SDK; custom native code goes through config plugins.

rtk.name: Redux Toolkit + RTK Query
rtk.summary: Server state in RTK Query per backend resource, three client slices, listener middleware for side effects.
rtk.tradeoff: More ceremony than Zustand; pays off once there are many resources and cross-slice reactions.

zustand.name: Zustand
zustand.summary: Small store with hooks, no boilerplate, pairs with TanStack Query for server state.
zustand.tradeoff: No built-in server cache or middleware bus; you compose those yourself.

rtk-query.name: RTK Query
rtk-query.summary: Cache, refetch, tags and optimistic updates inside the Redux store.

tanstack-query.name: TanStack Query
tanstack-query.summary: Server-state cache independent of your client store.
tanstack-query.tradeoff: A second source of truth next to the client store; keep the boundary explicit.

fetch.name: Plain fetch
fetch.summary: A typed fetch wrapper with the auth header and 401 handling, nothing cached.
fetch.tradeoff: You write caching and invalidation yourself when a screen needs it.

react-navigation.name: React Navigation
react-navigation.summary: Native stack, bottom tabs, conditional root navigator, deep links.
react-navigation.tradeoff: Nested navigation calls need the fully-qualified form from outside a tree.

expo-router.name: Expo Router
expo-router.summary: File-based routes on top of React Navigation.
expo-router.tradeoff: Expo only. Routes are files, so gating by role moves into layouts.

nativewind.name: NativeWind 4
nativewind.summary: Tailwind classes for React Native, driven by your token file.
nativewind.tradeoff: Structural layout through className is unreliable on Fabric; use inline style for width, height, flex, gaps. Tailwind must stay on 3.x.

unistyles.name: Unistyles 3
unistyles.summary: StyleSheet superset with themes, breakpoints and variants, computed on the native side.
unistyles.tradeoff: Nitro-based native module; adds a build-time Babel plugin.

stylesheet.name: StyleSheet
stylesheet.summary: Built-in styles with a small tokens module.
stylesheet.tradeoff: No theming or responsive helpers out of the box.

mmkv.name: MMKV
mmkv.summary: Synchronous key-value storage. Two instances: auth (wiped on logout) and default.
mmkv.tradeoff: Native Nitro module; needs a jest stub and a native rebuild on bumps.

async-storage.name: AsyncStorage
async-storage.tradeoff: Async rehydration gap at startup; slower than MMKV.

rhf-zod.name: React Hook Form + Zod
rhf-zod.summary: Uncontrolled forms with schema validation; the trio is pinned together.
rhf-zod.tradeoff: Resolvers v5 needs RHF 7.55+ and Zod 3.25+ or 4.

i18next.name: i18next
i18next.summary: All strings keyed in en.json from day one.
i18next.tradeoff: i18next and react-i18next bump as a pair.

flash-list.name: FlashList 2
flash-list.summary: Recycling list for the New Architecture; no estimatedItemSize.

crash.name: Sentry
crash.summary: JS and native crashes, release health, source map upload in CI.
crash.tradeoff: Changes native builds, so it ships in Sprint 0 or not at all.

analytics.name: Analytics facade
analytics.summary: Typed track/identify/reset with a no-op driver; vendor swapped later in one file.
analytics.tradeoff: None; retrofitting a taxonomy is what costs.

roles.name: Roles & capability gating
roles.summary: Additive roles on the user; named selectors; conditional navigator registration.
roles.tradeoff: Client gating is UX only; the server stays the authority.

media.name: Media & uploads
media.summary: Image picker, video playback and a presigned-PUT upload helper.
media.tradeoff: Large uploads need a real queue later.

push.name: Push (FCM)
push.summary: @react-native-firebase/messaging v26+, permission in context, device registration in the session listener.
push.tradeoff: iOS tokens need a real device; Firebase config files per environment.

bottom-sheet.name: Bottom Sheet
bottom-sheet.summary: Modal and persistent sheets on Reanimated + Gesture Handler.
bottom-sheet.tradeoff: Single maintainer, slow releases. Scrollables inside need its own list components.

fast-image.name: Fast Image
fast-image.summary: Cached, prioritised remote images; the maintained fork of react-native-fast-image.

datetimepicker.name: DateTime Picker
datetimepicker.summary: Native iOS and Android date and time pickers.
datetimepicker.tradeoff: Different UX per platform; wrap it in your own field.

lottie.name: Lottie
lottie.summary: After Effects animations exported as JSON, rendered natively.
lottie.tradeoff: Large JSON files hurt startup; keep them lazy.

webview.name: WebView
webview.summary: Embed web content with a native WebView.
webview.tradeoff: Allow-list every URL you load; never render untrusted HTML with JS enabled.

share.name: Share
share.summary: Native share sheet with files, images and app-specific targets.
share.tradeoff: iOS needs the share extension entitlements for some targets.

keychain.name: Keychain
keychain.summary: Store secrets in iOS Keychain and Android Keystore, with biometrics.
keychain.tradeoff: Pair with the auth token contract; do not duplicate MMKV storage.

clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.summary: Read and write the system clipboard.
clipboard.tradeoff: Android 12+ shows a toast on every read.

netinfo.name: NetInfo
netinfo.tradeoff: 'Connected' is not 'reachable'; check reachability for offline UI.

haptics.name: Haptic feedback
haptics.summary: Trigger native haptics on taps and confirmations.

image-picker.name: Image Picker
image-picker.summary: Pick photos and videos from the library or camera.
image-picker.tradeoff: Ask for permission in context, never at launch.

document-picker.name: Document Picker
document-picker.summary: Pick files from the system file provider; the maintained rename of react-native-document-picker.
document-picker.tradeoff: Returned URIs may be temporary; copy what you keep.

video.name: Video
video.summary: Video and inline audio playback with one library.
video.tradeoff: v7 is a Nitro rewrite in beta; this pins v6.

maps.name: Maps
maps.summary: Apple Maps and Google Maps with markers and overlays.
maps.tradeoff: Google Maps needs an API key and the Android SDK config.

device-info.name: Device Info
device-info.summary: App version, build number, device model and ids.
device-info.tradeoff: Some getters are async and some count as tracking on iOS.

vision-camera.name: Vision Camera
vision-camera.summary: Camera with frame processors, QR scanning and photo/video capture.
vision-camera.tradeoff: Nitro-based; heavy native setup and permissions.

permissions.name: Permissions
permissions.summary: One API to check and request every platform permission.
permissions.tradeoff: Each permission still needs its Info.plist / manifest entry.

google-signin.name: Google Sign-In
google-signin.tradeoff: Credential Manager on Android is in the paid Universal tier.

apple-auth.name: Apple Sign-In
apple-auth.summary: Sign in with Apple; required on iOS once any third-party login exists.
apple-auth.tradeoff: iOS only; Android needs the web flow.

purchases.name: RevenueCat Purchases
purchases.summary: In-app purchases and subscriptions across both stores.
purchases.tradeoff: A hosted service with its own pricing tiers.
